text: The meeting identified visibility issues stemming from the presenter's malfunctioning computer and reduced display size.
Decisions included skipping Teletext, targeting users under forty, and requiring the remote to feature an LCD screen with speech recognition, with the logo to be placed at the top.
The interface will use a two-group, paged menu for all functions, organized into display and basic functions, with the logo placement and corporate identity in mind.
Action items include preparing maps of all gathered data for planning, compiling a list of on-screen functions, and drafting the meeting minutes.
There must be a screen on the remote, reinforcing the decision for display presence.
